description:
Available chain-free,14 Cornwell Road is a contemporary townhouse in Trumpington with a distinctive arrangement of space. Set over three levels, the house combines four-bedroom flexibility with a notably generous living area, while the principal bedroom occupies the top floor with direct access onto a large private terrace.

The main living and dining room is particularly successful. A double-height section featuring a mezzanine balcony and substantial roof glazing giving the room a sense of volume and bringing natural light deep into the house, while glazed doors open directly onto the attractive rear garden. There is ample space to accommodate distinct sitting and dining areas without either feeling compromised, providing a picturesque outlook onto the rear garden. The kitchen is separate and practical, with a broad run of fitted cabinetry, extensive quartz work surfaces and integrated appliances. The ground floor space is completed by under-stairs storage and a separate cloakroom.

The bedroom accommodation is spread through the upper floors, creating useful separation from the main living space. The principal bedroom has the top floor to itself, with a distinct dressing area, en suite shower room and opening directly onto the substantial terrace, providing a private outside space that is a genuine additional feature of the house. On the first floor, there are a further two double bedrooms one with its own en-suite shower room and the other with access to the main bathroom, while the fourth bedroom is currently arranged as a study with a sliding door to the mezzanine balcony that overlooks the ground-floor living room below, demonstrating how readily the layout accommodates regular home working without taking over the living areas.

Outside, the attractive enclosed rear garden has been designed to be relatively easy to maintain, with gravelled areas, established planting and space for outdoor dining. Parking is another practical strength, with both a garage and carport providing considerably more flexibility than is often available with modern Cambridge housing.

Trumpington works particularly well for those who need straightforward access into Cambridge, the Biomedical Campus, the wider road network or trains into central London. Cornwell Road is within the established Great Kneighton area, with cycling routes and the Guided Busway providing useful alternatives to the car, while nearby green spaces give this part of south Cambridge a welcome sense of openness. Situated roughly a quarter of a mile from the Addenbrooke's Hospital / Cambridge Biomedical Campus, this property sits just a 12 minute walk, via Hobson Avenue, from the new Cambridge South railway station with, at peak travel times, up to nine trains every hour to central London stations.

Guide price £250,000 - £260,000

Situated in a well-connected location, this second floor, two-bedroom flat features a good-sized double bedroom and a single bedroom, ideal as a guest room, nursery or home office. A useful storage cupboard is located in the hallway, providing practical additional space.

The bright and spacious living/dining area offers plenty of room for both relaxation and entertaining. The kitchen benefits from good cupboard storage and has space for a fridge freezer and washing machine. Further benefits include bike racks and bin storage.

William Smith Close is located within short proximity to Cherry Hinton Road, Cambridge Leisure Retail Park, and notably Central Station being an 11 minute walk away, making it perfect for commuters.

The current owner in currently extending the lease and ids happy to negotiate with the cost of the lease extension taken into consideration.
keyFeatures: Close proximity to the mainline station
